description: Implementation of SNTP (Simple Network Time Protocol) client functions for time synchronization, including packet handling, response parsing, socket communication, and initialization.

methods.name: sntp_pkt_dump
methods.description: Dumps SNTP packet fields for debugging.

methods.name: q16_16_s_to_ll_us
methods.description: Converts 16.16 fixed point seconds to microseconds.

methods.name: q32_32_s_to_ll_us
methods.description: Converts 32.32 fixed point seconds to microseconds.

methods.name: parse_response
methods.description: Parses SNTP response packet and fills sntp_time structure.

methods.name: sntp_recv_response
methods.description: Receives SNTP response over socket and processes it.

methods.name: sntp_init
methods.description: Initializes SNTP context and socket connection.

methods.name: sntp_query
methods.description: Sends SNTP request and waits for response.
